text: {"found":true,"rule":{"trigger_kind":"incident","event":"sfp_replaced","symptoms":["link_up","counters_zero"],"stated_condition":"older units","condition_is_relative":true,"action":"interface.bounce","action_text":"disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again","avoid":["node.reboot"],"excerpt":"> If the interface is UP but the counters stay at zero on the older units, > disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again. > Don't reboot the unit.","said_by":"Erkki Expert","said_by_role":"expert","hedged":false,"first_hand":false,"outcome":"recovered","outcome_excerpt":"Thanks Erkki, did exactly that on TRN-087, traffic is back.","about_entity":"TRN-087"},"reason":"The quoted message from Erkki Expert states a reusable rule for when an interface is UP with zero counters on older units after an SFP swap, and Veikko confirms it resolved the issue."}
